description: Hover mega-menu navigation bar: triggers open large content panels (link columns, card grids — any ReactNode) after an intent dwell with a pointer grace period; controllable `activeValue`, Escape closes, arrows traverse triggers.
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
Hover mega-menu navigation bar: triggers open large content panels (link columns, card grids — any ReactNode) after an intent dwell with a pointer grace period; controllable `activeValue`, Escape closes, arrows traverse triggers. Exports: `NavigationMenu`, `NavigationMenuList`, `NavigationMenuItem`, `NavigationMenuTrigger`, `NavigationMenuContent`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/navigation-menu ``` The wrapper lands at `components/ui/haze/navigation-menu.tsx` (via the `@ui/` target placeholder from `components.json`) and re-exports the component(s) from the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically. ## Theming haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately — the installed wrapper already imports `haze-ui/css/tokens.css` and `haze-ui/css/navigation-menu.css`, so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
